imageGeneration.prompt: Create a fresh, clean proposed logo identity for the real dealership named D&M Auto Varna. This is an original new proposal, not a faithful copy of an existing logo. Exact text only: D&M AUTO and VARNA. Professional modern automotive wordmark: a simple distinctive geometric D&M monogram on the left, then D&M AUTO on the first line and VARNA on a substantial second line at least 60 percent of the main text height, so every word is readable in a 120px website header. Compact wide horizontal lockup, strong calm typography, optically balanced spacing. Flat deep charcoal/navy #17212b lettering with one restrained rich red #b00020 detail in the monogram. No detailed car drawing, no BMW grille, no wheel, no metallic or faceted texture, no gradient, no thin strokes, no phone number, no tagline, no stars, no enclosing plate. All letter counters and gaps fully transparent, antialiased crisp edges. Only one complete logo, no presentation mockup or repeated variations. True RGBA transparent background, modest transparent padding, landscape canvas with large usable logo.
